answer: Sybil attacks break when each new agent must have an existing member post a slashable bond to vouch for it. If a fake cluster misbehaves, every voucher along the chain loses stake, so one bad actor named Zephyr can burn the bonds of all who backed it. An attacker spinning up a thousand violet shell identities must either fund a thousand real deposits or recruit honest vouchers now facing a horizon of guaranteed losses. Behaving stays cheap; forging a crowd stays ruinously expensive.
